title: Biomechanics Contribution in Osteoarthritis Development Using Cartilage-on-Chip Model
author: Faure, Chobaz, et al.
materials: This section describes how to isolate, amplify and prepare primary human chondrocytes for injection in the devices.1.Isolation.a.Isolate chondrocytes form osteoarthritic cartilage.1 Briefly, separate macroscopically chosen undamaged cartilage from the subchondral bone using a scalpel.b.Cut it in small pieces and wash twice with 37°C warm PBS and twice with DMEM.c.Digest cartilage for around 10 hours in 10% Liberase (Roche) DMEM.d.The following day, pass the digested tissue through a 70 μm filter to obtain articular chondrocytes.2.Amplification of cells.a.Count the isolated cells and plate them at 1 × 106 cells per T150 flask.b.Let them amplify in DMEM + 10% FBS for 14 days.3.Preparation.a.Once cells reach confluency, wash with 10 mL of 37°C warm PBS twice.b.Detach cells with 5 mL 37°C warm Tris-EDTA.c.Adjust cell concentration to 6 × 106 cells/mL in normal medium.

steps.title: Isolate primary human chondrocytes
steps.instruction: Separate undamaged cartilage from subchondral bone with a scalpel, cut into small pieces, wash twice with 37 °C warm PBS and twice with DMEM, digest in 10 % Liberase (Roche) DMEM for ~10 h, then filter the next day through a 70 µm filter to obtain chondrocytes.

steps.title: Amplify isolated chondrocytes
steps.instruction: Count the isolated cells and plate at 1 × 10⁶ cells per T150 flask; culture in DMEM + 10 % FBS for 14 days until confluent.

steps.title: Prepare cells for injection
steps.instruction: Wash confluent cultures twice with 10 mL 37 °C warm PBS, detach with 5 mL 37 °C warm Tris‑EDTA, and resuspend to a concentration of 6 × 10⁶ cells / mL in normal medium.

steps.title: Prepare 4 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2 g low‑melting agarose in 55 mL sterile PBS in an Erlenmeyer (use 55 mL to compensate for evaporation), heat until clumps disappear, cover with sterile aluminum foil and place in a 57 °C water bath for 10 min to remove bubbles.

steps.title: Inject cell‑agarose mixture into chip
steps.instruction: Mix 400 µL cell suspension with 400 µL molten 4 % agarose on a 37 °C heating block, pipette up‑and‑down until homogeneous, withdraw 50 µL of the mixture and gently inject into the chip cell chamber until filled.

steps.title: Mechanical actuation of chips
steps.instruction: After 7 days culture in normal medium, aspirate medium from the chip top (P200 or absorbent paper), collect 20 µL perfusion‑channel medium with a P20 pipette and store at –20 °C for PEA, add ~150 µL fresh medium to channel and chip top, then actuate at 300 mbar, 1 Hz for 1 h per day:

substeps.instruction: For gene‑expression studies: actuate 2 consecutive days.
For gel‑staining / proteomics: actuate 5 consecutive days.
Perform actuation at the same clock time each day.
After actuation, rest chips for 1 day (gene‑expression) or 2 days (staining/proteomics).
Collect and store medium before gel harvest.

steps.title: Alizarin Red staining of gels
steps.instruction: Remove agarose gel from chip onto a microscope slide, wash twice with 100 µL PBS, fix cells with 100 µL frozen (–20 °C) methanol, incubate slide at 4 °C for 10 min, wash with 100 µL PBS then 100 µL distilled water, stain with 100 µL 0.5 % Alizarin Red (pH 4.2) for 1 h at 20 °C, wash three times with 100 µL tap water (30 s each), replace with 100 µL PBS, image the whole gel (Olympus BX43, UplanFl ×4 NA 0.13) and three fields at two depths (UplanFl ×10 NA 0.30), then quantify red signal using Fiji.

steps.title: Extract RNA from gel‑embedded cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate perfusion‑channel medium, wash with 30 µL PBS (pipette up‑down 10×) and discard; add 50 µL RNA dissociation buffer, pipette up‑down ≥20×, collect the lysate, add an equal volume of 70 % ethanol (e.g., 50 µL ethanol to 50 µL lysate) and mix, transfer up to 700 µL to a RNeasy spin column in a 2 mL collection tube, centrifuge 15 s ≥8000 × g, discard flow‑through, add 700 µL Buffer RW1 and centrifuge 15 s ≥8000 × g, discard, add 500 µL Buffer RPE, centrifuge 15 s ≥8000 × g, discard, add another 500 µL Buffer RPE, centrifuge 2 min ≥8000 × g, place column in a new 2 mL tube, centrifuge 1 min at 17000 × g, transfer to a new 1.5 mL tube, add 30 µL RNase‑free water to the membrane, centrifuge 1 min ≥8000 × g, place eluate on ice and measure RNA concentration (1 µL) with a Nanodrop.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA from RNA
steps.instruction: Calculate RNA volume to obtain the desired amount (fixed 20 ng / µL concentration, volume = desired ng ÷ 20), add nuclease‑free water to reach 15 µL total, place ice, retrieve iScript cDNA kit from –20 °C, keep on ice, label PCR strip tubes (operator initials, date, sample code), assemble each 20 µL reaction: 4 µL 5× iScript mix, 1 µL iScript reverse transcriptase, calculated water, and calculated RNA (100 fg‑1 µg total), mix by pipetting up‑down 10×, seal, spin down, run thermocycler: 5 min @ 25 °C, 20 min @ 46 °C, 1 min @ 95 °C, hold at 4 °C (optional). Store strips at –20 °C if qPCR is not immediate.

steps.title: Set up and run qPCR
steps.instruction: Determine cDNA amount to deliver 10 ng per reaction (e.g., 2 µL of 5 ng/µL cDNA), calculate water to reach 20 µL total, prepare master mix per primer: 10 µL IQ SYBR Green Mix, 1 µL 10 µM reverse primer, 1 µL 10 µM forward primer, cDNA volume, water to 20 µL; keep all components on ice, dilute 100 µM primer stocks to 10 µM if needed, thaw cDNA on ice, add cDNA to a 96‑well plate, add master mix, include negative‑control (no‑template) and water control, mix by pipetting up‑down 10×, seal plate, spin 15 s, run on Bio‑Rad qPCR instrument with program: 5 min @ 95 °C; 15 s @ 95 °C; 30 s @ 60 °C (repeat 39 cycles); melt 65‑95 °C at 0.5 °C steps for 5 min; start run (~2 h). Analyze data using the 2‑ΔΔCt method.

steps.title: Immunofluorescence staining of gels
steps.instruction: Detach gels from chips onto microscope slides, fix with 100 µL 4 % PFA for 30 min at 20 °C, wash twice with 100 µL PBS, optionally store chips 48 h at 4 °C, permeabilize with 100 µL 0.25 % Triton X‑100 in PBS for 30 min at 20 °C, wash three times with 100 µL PBS, block with 100 µL 1 % BSA in PBS for 1 h at 20 °C, prepare primary‑antibody cocktail in 1 % BSA (TRPV4‑Alexa 594 1/150, LOX polyclonal 1/200, β‑actin‑Alexa 647 1/150), incubate gels with 50 µL cocktail overnight at 4 °C, wash next day three times with 100 µL PBS, incubate with 100 µL Alexa Fluor 488 secondary (1/500) for 1 h at 20 °C to detect LOX, wash three times with 100 µL PBS, mount with DAPI‑containing mounting medium, acquire images (3 fields 25‑30 µm depth at ×20 and 1 field at ×63 using Zeiss LSM 880 Airyscan), convert Z‑stacks to 2‑D in Fiji and quantify fluorescence intensity.

steps.title: Measure secreted proteins by Olink PEA
steps.instruction: Thaw the tubes containing cumulative medium collected in step 6, assay 5 µL of each supernatant with the Olink Target 96 Inflammation panel, then analyse the data to generate volcano plots and NPX graphs for the 92 inflammation‑related proteins.
